# Do NOT edit backend (.py) files, only edit frontend (html/css/js, templates/static folders) files

1. Most templates extends from global 'base.html' or 'popup.html'.
2. Choose px instead of rem/em for CSS (if rem/em is found, convert it to px using the default 16px baseline).
3. Ensure that the design considers both light and dark modes.
4. Make sure that the file/code structure follows good design patterns, and is easy to understand for humans (with good comments as well).
5. Make each page optimized for SEO.
